Exceptional Three-Bedroom Detached Family Residence on a Generous Mature Site
We are delighted to present this property for sale, a lovely detached family home that perfectly balances pleasant living with countryside tranquillity. Set on a generous private site just minutes from Kilkenny City, this well-maintained residence offers great size and versatile accommodation extending to approximately 1,097 sq. ft., making it an ideal family home or those seeking a peaceful rural setting with easy access to Kilkenny City.
Perfectly positioned in the highly sought-after Dunbell area, the property offers the best of both worlds—peaceful rural surroundings with Kilkenny City, the M9 motorway, schools, shops and local amenities all within easy reach.
From the moment you arrive, the property makes an excellent first impression with its crisp white façade and mature landscaped surroundings. Inside, the home has been thoughtfully modernised while retaining a warm and welcoming atmosphere throughout.
The accommodation begins with a bright entrance hall leading into a comfortable living room, where a feature handcrafted natural stone fireplace with solid fuel stove creates a cosy focal point. Large windows flood the room with natural light, while the unique open staircase adds character and a sense of space.
The heart of the home is the spacious kitchen and dining area, fitted with an excellent range of contemporary units, quality worktops and integrated appliances. Exposed stone detailing adds charm and individuality, while the adjoining sunroom provides a wonderful additional living space overlooking the gardens. With French doors opening onto the patio, this bright room is perfect for entertaining, relaxing or enjoying family use throughout the year.
To the rear of the property is a large ground floor bedroom, this room currently serves as a home gym but offers endless flexibility as a second living room, playroom or home office depending on the needs of the new owners.
A spacious family bathroom is located on the ground floor and is finished to a high standard with modern sanitary ware and is in showroom condition.

Upstairs, the property offers two generous double bedrooms, the impressive principal bedroom featuring vaulted ceilings and rooflights that create a bright, airy retreat. A further spacious bedroom completes the first floor, providing excellent accommodation for family living.
Outside, the property enjoys mature gardens with extensive lawn areas, gravel driveways and patio spaces ideal for outdoor entertaining. The generous site provides privacy, excellent parking and plenty of room for children to play while enjoying the peaceful countryside setting. A large detached workshop will appeal to many buyers.
Special Features
•	Detached family residence on a generous private site 
•	Approx. 1,097 sq. ft. of well-appointed accommodation 
•	Three spacious bedrooms 
•	Bright sunroom with garden access 
•	Modern fitted kitchen with quality finishes 
•	Feature natural stone fireplace with solid fuel stove 
•	Vaulted ceilings and rooflights to the principal bedroom 
•	Oil-fired central heating 
•	PVC double-glazed windows 
•	Large detached workshed 
•	Mature gardens with patio and lawn areas 
•	Excellent countryside location just a short drive from Kilkenny City 
•	Easy access to the M9 motorway, schools and local amenities 
A virtual tour of the property is available to allow prospective purchasers to explore the home in detail before arranging a viewing. 
Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, space and exceptional setting this wonderful family home has to offer.
